summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of TipJar MVP. All 28 backend pytest cases pass (auth, tips CRUD, rating, admin, leaderboard, credits, notifications). All critical frontend flows verified: landing (jar + bell + language switcher), bell toggle (no login), DE/EL language switch with umlauts, signup with 100 welcome credits, submit modal (tutorial 4-step incl. Argentina vs Cape Verde + upload+scan+publish), Rate Wall card render + 10-star rate + confetti/toast, Wallet Buy/Gift/Redeem tabs, Admin login + settle Won.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~712 lines. Consider splitting into modules (auth, tips, credits, notifications, storage) once >800 lines for maintainability.

analyze_tip returns fallback rating=5 when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has 0 balance (litellm.BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded'). This is EXPECTED per problem statement — no action needed until key is topped up. Observed real Gemini rating during E2E run, so key intermittently works.
GET /api/tips has no server-side limit param safeguard (fetches up to 500 docs then slices in Python). Fine for MVP; add DB-side pagination when tip volume grows.
PUT /api/tips/{id}/status accepts any admin — no audit log of who settled a tip. Consider recording admin_id + timestamp on tips for accountability.
Stripe checkout success flow polls up to 6 times (12s). If webhook fires meanwhile, that also credits — good idempotency via `credited` flag.
Rating own tip is currently allowed (a user can rate their own tip). Not called out in the spec; flag as product decision.
Frontend: user can also rate settled (won/lost) tips because RateWall renders the star strip regardless of status. Consider disabling stars when status != pending.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 critical flows: landing, bell, DE, EL, signup, publish-tip, rate-tip, wallet-tabs, admin-settle)

test_credentials: Admin admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! (works). New E2E test users are created dynamically with prefix TEST_ or e2e_.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed disposable TEST_-prefixed users and one published tip per run. Admin is seeded by backend startup hook.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; pytest.ini enforces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope so all classes in the single test file are pinned to the same worker (safe for shared pytest attrs). To re-run: `cd /app && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The AI fallback rating (5.0 + 'Auto-rating unavailable') was accepted as a PASS per problem statement, though during E2E the LLM occasionally succeeded (returned rating 5 with real English analysis). If LLM key gets topped up, ratings may vary. Rating a tip more than once by same user does NOT double-count. Streak advances only once per calendar day.
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. Two transient playwright test-script flakes occurred: (a) initial run hit a 502 on /api/auth/register because the backend was hot-reloading due to my test file additions (`WatchFiles detected changes in 'tests/backend_test.py'`); resolved on rerun. (b) In one pass, the header submit modal did not open on click right after signup because of overlay/animation timing — the immediately subsequent test opened it successfully. Recommend increasing the auth modal close animation grace period before opening the next modal, but this is cosmetic and does not affect users.
